atos_build.name: Model build-time gates
atos_build.note: The seven manufacture gates proposed for the SLM Factory. No control in the Group questionnaire covers them, which is why the bench carries them explicitly.

items.M1: Base model intake: licence, provenance, weight integrity, serialization format
items.M2: Training data: lineage, classification, purpose, NDA scope, extraction testing
items.M3: Distillation: teacher terms of use, perimeter egress, inherited behaviour
items.M4: Fine-tuning: reproducible run, dataset fingerprint, alignment regression
items.M5: Quantization: evaluate the artefact actually delivered
items.M6: Packaging: signature, AI-BOM, model card, independent verification
items.M7: Promotion: go-live gate, rollback, evidence pack

gap_notes.M3: A distillation gate asks whether a student inherited the properties of its teacher, which needs both artefacts and a comparison between them. This tool evaluates one served model at a time and has no access to the teacher, so nothing here can answer it. Bias and slant measurements were mapped to this gate at one point and the mapping was withdrawn: inherited slant is a consequence of distillation, not a measurement of its integrity, and claiming the gate on that basis is the overreach this tool exists to prevent.

items.GOVERN: Policies, accountability and culture for AI risk
items.MEASURE: Analysis, assessment and tracking of identified risks

atos_blocks.name: Atos CyS agentic AI control blocks
atos_blocks.note: The nineteen building blocks of the Group self-assessment questionnaire, 227 actionable items in total. Only some of them can be exercised by sending a prompt to a model; the rest are organisational or architectural and are answered by the questionnaire itself. Those are marked out of probe scope rather than counted as gaps, so the coverage figure means something.

items.1: Identity and trust across the agentic workflow
items.2: Approved models, agents, tools and connectors
items.5: Plan-time policy checks and risk classification
items.6: Runtime execution supervision and tool guardrails
items.8: Output safety, nondisclosure and policy enforcement
items.11: Third-party, supply chain and external dependency control
items.15: Decentralized planning, delegation and consensus control
items.16: Runtime supervision for decentralized multi-agent execution
items.18: Runtime anomaly detection for cross-agent coordination
items.19: Incident response for decentralized and hybrid multi-agent systems
